card.line: Baal-peor was a mountain linked to the Moabite god Baal of Peor, where Israel turned from the LORD and was judged, a warning later remembered.

moments.title: Israel follows Baal of Peor
moments.text: Israel yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods. This made the LORD angry, and a plague broke out among them.

moments.title: Moses reminds Israel
moments.text: Moses told the people they had seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor. He destroyed all who followed Baal of Peor, but those who held fast to the LORD were still alive.

moments.title: Hosea recalls the shame
moments.text: The LORD said He found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. But they went to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to Shame, and became as detestable as the thing they loved.
